who.title: Who may review
who.description: verified_buyers: only customers with a completed order of the item (identity or a request link); identified: any signed-in customer (verified when a purchase is found); anyone: also guests (never auto-approved unless moderation allows unverified reviews).

one_review_per.title: One review per
one_review_per.description: order_item: a customer may review the same item again after another purchase; item: once per item.

send_on_completion.title: Send the review request when the order completes
send_on_completion.description: On (with the request flow on): the request goes out as soon as order.completed@1 arrives, together with the website's other due requests and reminders. Off: requests wait until you run the flow (dashboard or POST /v1/request-flow:run). There is no delayed send: it would need a scheduled job, which this product does not run.

review_window_days.title: Verified reviews accepted for (days)
review_window_days.description: How long after completion a purchase still counts as verified and the request stays open.

link_ttl_days.title: Review link lifetime (days)
link_ttl_days.description: Lifetime of the signed review links in request messages (no sign-in needed).

reviewer_name.title: Public reviewer name
reviewer_name.description: How the author is shown publicly; full names and contact details are never shown otherwise.

max_reviews_per_customer_per_day.title: Reviews per customer per day
max_reviews_per_customer_per_day.description: Abuse guard: submissions by one customer in a rolling 24 hours.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA zone of the website: moderation rules (dateParts, between), quiet hours and analytics buckets.
